nodes.rationale: Trailing ~ makes Unity ignore it, keeping dev notes, Marketing/ and Tools/petgen.mjs out of the Asset Store package.

nodes.label: GlobalPetSettings Load Fallback Chain
nodes.rationale: Use package Items asset, else any in project, else create it from Heart/Ball/Bowl so the package own asset wins over stray copies.

nodes.label: Lazy Pet List Loading (allPets null until used)
nodes.norm_label: lazy pet list loading (allpets null until used)
nodes.rationale: Right after a domain reload FindAssets can return 0; SyncPets skips loading while isUpdating/isCompiling so pets no longer vanish after recompile.

nodes.label: Window Tick Polling (schedule.Execute every 120 ms)
nodes.rationale: Polling tiles, counter and filter reflects any change (Undo, Inspector, Scene View) without per-tile bindings.

nodes.label: Location-Independent Paths via asmdef GUID
nodes.rationale: Lets the EditorPets folder live anywhere under Assets/ or be installed under Packages/.

nodes.label: isActive as Single Source of Truth for Visibility
nodes.norm_label: isactive as single source of truth for visibility
nodes.rationale: Replaced overlapping location Scene/House flag; per-update re-sync makes Undo, inspector edits and asset add/delete show without manual reload.

nodes.label: Removed Sample Backyard Scene
nodes.rationale: Pets are a Scene View overlay and never interacted with the 3D yard.

nodes.label: Editor-Only Assembly (EditorPets.Editor.asmdef)
nodes.rationale: includePlatforms Editor: faster compilation, namespace isolation, zero build footprint, any render pipeline.

nodes.label: Scene View Pet Overlay (editor-only, not GameObjects)
nodes.norm_label: scene view pet overlay (editor-only, not gameobjects)
nodes.rationale: Pets are drawn with Handles/GUI in SceneView.duringSceneGui so nothing is added to scenes or builds.

nodes.label: Repaint Throttled to 30 FPS (forced during drag)
nodes.norm_label: repaint throttled to 30 fps (forced during drag)

nodes.norm_label: auto texture import fix (sprite / point / no compression)
nodes.rationale: Default import scales to power of 2, which breaks frame counting; already configured textures are left untouched.

nodes.rationale: Only Idle is required, lowering the bar for custom pets; Walk and Play share a sheet, Interact uses Petted.
